director.name: 汉诺·欧德蒂森 Hanno Olderdissen

introduction: When Thomas is released from prison, he learns that he has inherited a valuable house. There’s just one catch: his half-brother Roland has the right to live there for the rest of his life. Thomas settles in anyway and employs all manner of tricks, hoping to manipulate his unwelcome housemate into moving out. Roland, however, proves to be surprisingly strong-willed.
